definitions.explanation: A large, impressive house or residence, typically belonging to a wealthy or high-status family. The お prefix adds a sense of respect or refinement.

examples.english: You can see a mansion on the hill.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧お{屋敷|やしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{庭園|ていえん}→庭園：12452_teien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That mansion has a spacious garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武家|ぶけ}→武家：13242_buke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{屋敷|やしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Some samurai mansions from the Edo period still remain as tourist sites today.

notes:
The polite prefix お adds refinement and is standard when referring to mansions or grand residences. Without the prefix, ⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧ alone can refer to any large dwelling but sounds more neutral or historical. In modern usage, お{屋敷|やしき} often evokes old money, traditional architecture, or historical estates.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{屋敷|やしき}⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧ — upscale residential neighborhood
- お{屋敷|やしき}⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ — mansion district (historical)
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧お{屋敷|やしき} — old mansion
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧なお{屋敷|やしき} — splendid mansion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧ — mansion, estate (without polite prefix)
- ⟦{邸宅|ていたく}→邸宅：14434_teitaku⟧ — residence, mansion (formal, written style)
- ⟦{豪邸|ごうてい}→豪邸：18158_goutei⟧ — grand mansion (emphasizes luxury and size)
